bodyHtml:
👋 About Us · Logan & Surrounds

About Computer Repairs Logan. The Technician You Actually Talk To.

No call centre, no ticket number, no runaround. Just a local technician who picks up the phone and tells you straight what's wrong.

Who We Are

Twenty Years Of Fixing Things Properly.

My name's Robert. I've been repairing computers for twenty years, starting out as a Microsoft Certified Professional before becoming the youngest person IBM Australia had hired at the time. Since then I've worked on everything from a cracked laptop screen the night before an assignment was due to full office network rebuilds, and solving a problem someone else has given up on still doesn't get old.

Computer Repairs Logan is also known as Zoo Computer Repairs across Brisbane, and we've been featured on Channel 9 News. The day-to-day work hasn't changed much though. Someone calls with a computer that won't start, I ask a few questions, and we work out together whether it's worth fixing or time to let it go.

Why Local Matters

We're Down The Road, Not On Hold.

Logan Central, Woodridge, Loganlea, Springwood, Beenleigh, Browns Plains and Shailer Park aren't just a list of suburbs on a website. It's where we actually drive to. If your laptop dies before a deadline or your business network drops out on a Monday morning, you're talking to the person doing the repair, not a booking system three states away.

How We Work

Straight Answers Before Any Work Starts.

You get a price before we touch anything, and we'll tell you honestly if a repair isn't worth it. No inflated diagnostic fees, no upselling a new machine when a $60 part will do.

  • A quote before we start. You know the price before we touch your computer, not after.
  • Honest advice, even if it costs us the job. If a repair isn't worth it, we'll say so.
  • The person you call is the person who fixes it. No handoffs, no second technician starting over.
  • Onsite, drop-off or remote. Whatever's easiest for you, not us.

Talk To Me Directly.

Call and you'll get a straight answer, not a script.

Call 07 3144 6777 Send A Message
